description: This file defines a Java class 'TabAdapter' that extends FragmentPagerAdapter to manage tabbed fragments in an Android application. It provides fragments for a receipt list and receipt addition based on tab position.

classes.name: TabAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for managing 'ReceiptsList' and 'ReceiptsAdd' fragments in a tabbed interface.

methods.name: TabAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with context, fragment manager, and total number of tabs.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the fragment associated with a specified position (0 for list, 1 for add receipt).

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of tabs.
